Title: Requires hospitals to provide disposable diapers and wipes and infant formula for newborns and menstrual products at the time of discharge
Summary: Requires hospitals which provide maternity services to provide disposable diapers and wipes and offer a one-week supply of infant formula for newborns, and to provide a supply of menstrual products, at the time of discharge; clarifies that offering and providing such infant formula shall not affect a hospital's eligibility to participate in the department of health's breastfeeding friendly practice designation program.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to requiring hospitals to provide disposable diapers and wipes for newborns and menstrual products and offer infant formula for newborns at the time of discharge
